lead_raw_text:
The structure of Mg₂V₂S₄ (MgVS₂) crystallizes in the orthorhombic space group Amm2 (No. 38), with 8 atoms per unit cell distributed over 4 independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis shows Mg centers with 5 neighbors (2 Mg, 3 S), V centers with 4 neighbors (2 S, 2 V), and S centers with either 6 neighbors (1 Mg, 1 S, 4 V) or 4 neighbors (3 Mg, 1 S). The geometric neighbor graph is 3-dimensional, and validated polyhedron contacts reveal corner- and edge-sharing between Mg 5-vertex and S 6-vertex polyhedra, as well as between S 6-vertex and S 4-vertex polyhedra.
